# Lemmas about directional derivatives This file provides lemmas about directional derivatives. It includes standard theorems (the Extreme Value Theorem, Rolle's theorem, the Mean Value Theorem, etc.).

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
Import Order.TTheory GRing.Theory Num.Theory.
Import numFieldNormedType.Exports.

Local Open Scope ring_scope.
Local Open Scope classical_set_scope.

Lemma der1_scaleLRSource code kSource code fSource code xSource code : derivable k x 1 -> derivable f x 1 ->
  h^-1 *: (((fun x0Source code => k x0 *: f x0) \o  shift x) h%:A - k x *: f x)
  @[hSource code --> 0^'] --> 'D_1 k x *: f x + k x *: 'D_1 f x.
Proof.
move=> der_k der_f/=; rewrite (@near_eq_cvg_eq _ _ _ _ _
    (fun hSource code => (h^-1 * (k (h%:A + x) - k x)) *: f (h%:A + x) +
              k x *: (h^-1 *: (f (h%:A + x) - f x)))).
  near=> h.
  rewrite scalerA (mulrC (k x)) -(scalerA h^-1 (k x)) -scalerA -scalerDr.
  by congr (_ *: _); rewrite scalerBl scalerBr addrA subrK.
apply: cvgD.
- apply/(cvgZ der_k)/(@cvg_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ (nbhs x)).
  + apply: cvg0D => //;  apply: (@cvg0M _ _ _ _ _ _ 1) => //.
    exact: cvg_within_filter.
  + rewrite -/(continuous_at x f).
    exact/differentiable_continuous/derivable1_diffP.
- exact: cvgZl_tmp der_f.
Unshelve. all: by end_near. Qed.

Global Instance is_derive1ZLRSource code kSource code fSource code xSource code (dkSource code : R) (dfSource code : V) :

  is_derive x 1 (fun xSource code => k x *: f x) (dk *: f x + k x *: df).
Proof.
move=> [der_k <-] [der_f <-]/=; apply: DeriveDef.
- exact: cvgP (der1_scaleLR _ _).
- by apply: norm_cvg_lim; exact: cvg_trans (der1_scaleLR _ _).
Qed.

Section Derive_lemmasVR.

Fact der_multSource code fSource code gSource code xSource code vSource code :
  derivable f x v -> derivable g x v ->
  (fun hSource code => h^-1 *: (((f * g) \o shift x) (h *: v) - (f * g) x)) @
  0^' --> f x *: 'D_v g x + g x *: 'D_v f x.
Proof.
move=> df dg.
evar (fg : R -> R); rewrite [X in X @ _](_ : _ = fg) /=.
  rewrite funeqE => h.
  have -> : (f * g) (h *: v + x) - (f * g) x =
    f (h *: v + x) *: (g (h *: v + x) - g x) + g x *: (f (h *: v + x) - f x).
    by rewrite !scalerBr -addrA ![g x *: _]mulrC addKr.
  rewrite scalerDr scalerA mulrC -scalerA.
  by rewrite [_ *: (g x *: _)]scalerA mulrC -scalerA /fg.
apply: cvgD; last exact: cvgZl_tmp df.
apply: cvg_comp2 (@scale_continuous _ _ _ (_, _)) => /=; last exact: dg.
suff : {for 0, continuous (fun hSource code : R => f(h *: v + x))}.
  by move=> /continuous_withinNx; rewrite scale0r add0r.
exact/differentiable_continuous/derivable1_diffP/(derivable1P _ _ _).1.
Qed.

Fact der_invSource code fSource code xSource code vSource code : f x != 0 -> derivable f x v ->
  (fun hSource code => h^-1 *: (((fun ySource code => (f y)^-1) \o shift x) (h *: v) - (f x)^-1)) @
  0^' --> - (f x) ^-2 *: 'D_v f x.
Proof.
move=> fxn0 df.
have /derivable1P/derivable1_diffP/differentiable_continuous := df.
move=> /continuous_withinNx; rewrite scale0r add0r => fc.
have fn0 : 0^' [set hSource code | f (h *: v + x) != 0].
  apply: (fc [set xSource code | x != 0]); exists `|f x|; first by rewrite /= normr_gt0.
  move=> y; rewrite /= => yltfx.
  by apply/eqP => y0; move: yltfx; rewrite y0 subr0 ltxx.
have : (fun hSource code => - ((f x)^-1 * (f (h *: v + x))^-1) *:
  (h^-1 *: (f (h *: v + x) - f x))) @ 0^' -->

Arguments left_derivative_limit {R f} df.

For $a \in \mathbb{R}$ and $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$, if: 1. $f$ is continuous at $a$ 2. $f$ is derivable near $a$ (but not necessarily *at* $a$) 3. The limit of $f'(x)$ as $x \to a, x \neq a$ exists and equals $\ell \in \mathbb{R}$ Then $f$ is derivable at $a$ and $f'(a) = \ell$.

suff dcvg : h^-1 *: (f (h%:A + a) - f a) @[hSource code --> 0^'] --> l.
  by split; [ exact: cvgP dcvg | exact: norm_cvg_lim dcvg ].
under eq_cvg do rewrite scaler1.
apply: cvg_at_right_left_dnbhs.
- apply: (right_derivative_limit df).
  + exact: cvg_at_right_filter cfa.

  + exact: cvg_dnbhs_at_left.
Qed.
